content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital products

The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure is a permanent structural alternative to the payment processing limitations imposed by Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad. It's a base-layer infrastructure that gives creators full control over their online stores, automatic crypto payment verification, and instant product delivery, all while maintaining full data ownership. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a purpose-built solution that addresses the root causes of the problem.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure is built using a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. It starts with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, followed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. The payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a fee of only 0.5%.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure provides a permanent structural alternative to the payment processing limitations imposed by Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure is composed of several key components, including the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), Edge Commerce Stack ($197), and the Sovereign Blueprint ($47). The Edge Commerce Stack, for example, is a comprehensive solution that includes Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours, Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff. This stack can be deployed in just 48 hours and comes with 30-day support.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The most important question on every creator's mind is: 'How do I sell digital products without Stripe?' The answer is simple: use the Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure, which provides a permanent structural alternative to Stripe's limitations. With this infrastructure, you can sell digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, and maintain full control over your online store and your data.
By using the Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure, creators can maintain full control over their online stores and their data.

If you're looking for a solution to sell digital products without Stripe in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or other restricted countries, look no further than the Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure. Our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive solution that includes everything you need to get started, from Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours to 5 products loaded and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. Visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure today, follow these concrete steps: select the stack that best suits your needs from our product page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html; choose your payment method and configure your NOWPayments integration; upload your digital products to your online store; configure your SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings for email validation; and test your infrastructure to ensure everything is working as expected.
